frontend_architecture.why: Modern, performant UI with strong type safety and fast dev cycle; matches target users' need for lightweight tool.

alternatives_rejected.Flutter: Requires native binaries, heavier bundle size, not ideal for simple web app
alternatives_rejected.SvelteKit: Less mature ecosystem, no TypeScript support in current version

tradeoffs: Client-side only; no server-rendered SEO benefits
No built-in state persistence beyond localStorage
failure_conditions: Browser compatibility issues with ES modules
Large UI causing performance degradation on low-end devices

confidence.justification: Best fit for lightweight, fast UI with strong typing and offline-first use case.

backend_architecture.why: High performance, automatic OpenAPI generation, async support; ideal for CRUD operations with minimal overhead.

alternatives_rejected.Django REST Framework: Overkill for simple app, slower startup, heavier dependencies
alternatives_rejected.Express.js: Node.js single-threaded, not suitable for high-throughput concurrent writes

tradeoffs: Relies on client trust for input validation

confidence.justification: Optimal balance of speed, simplicity, and scalability for CRUD-only use case.

database_primary.why: ACID compliance ensures data integrity after restarts; supports constraints like non-empty titles via CHECK.

alternatives_rejected.SQLite 3.40.0: File-based, not suitable for concurrent writes under load
alternatives_rejected.MySQL 8.0: Overkill, no native support for JSONB in this simple schema

tradeoffs: Requires containerized deployment with proper tuning
Not a distributed database; single-node limitation
failure_conditions: Write lock contention under high load

confidence.justification: Best choice for persistent, crash-safe storage with built-in validation.

api_protocol.why: Secure, efficient transport; required by CON-001 security boundary.
tradeoffs: No server-sent events or real-time updates (non-goal)

confidence.justification: Mandatory for security and modern performance; no viable alternative.

storage_strategy.why: Simple, zero-configuration storage that survives restarts via file write.

alternatives_rejected.Redis: Overkill for single-user app, adds complexity

failure_conditions: Write lock contention under high load

confidence.justification: Minimal viable storage solution matching MVP scope.
